figures.label: Industry Growth Rate
figures.source: India's creator economy is valued at roughly USD 15 billion in 2026 and is projected to climb toward USD 62 billion by 2033, and job postings tied to it have grown more than 900% since 2020 as brands build in-house creator teams instead of treating influencer marketing as a one-off spend.

visuals.heading: Traditional Companies Are Building In-House Creator Teams

items.text: Strong writing, communication, or negotiation instincts, talent management and brand partnerships run on relationships, not just spreadsheets.
Genuine editing, filming, or design skill you can show through sample work, even if it was built for a small client or a personal project.
Comfort with data, engagement rates, campaign reporting, and platform analytics are now core parts of brand-side and agency-side roles, not extras.

blocks.heading: Start Inside a Small Brand or Agency

items.text: Build one visible case study before you apply.
Follow the tool companies, not just the brands.
Turn your case study into a named, priced offer, not a vague pitch.
If you're freelancing into this space, get your first few clients through people, not job boards.
